title: Data Selection for Multi-turn Dialogue Instruction Tuning
authors_zh: Bo Li, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
paper_type_zh: 多轮对话指令数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 为对话监督微调筛选连贯且多样的会话历史的读者。
one_line: MDS selects complete dialogue trajectories by combining user-intent coverage with entity-grounded and form-consistent structure.
MDS 以用户意图覆盖以及实体扎根、形式一致的结构选择完整对话轨迹。
why: It moves the SFT admission decision from isolated turns to the complete dialogue trajectory.
inclusion_reason: It decides which complete multi-turn dialogue records are consumed by SFT using coverage and structural criteria.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Large multi-turn dialogue pools contain failure modes that are invisible when each turn is scored separately: later requests can drift from the original intent, assistant messages can become repetitive, and answers can ignore the form that a user asked for. Selecting a collection of individually strong turns can therefore still yield incoherent trajectories for multi-turn instruction tuning.

MDS asks which complete conversations should enter a fixed dialogue-level SFT budget. It changes the training records from an unfiltered dialogue pool into a set chosen for both coverage of user-intent trajectories and reliability within each trajectory. The intervention is not a conversational model architecture or a dialogue judge at inference time; it decides which entire conversation histories become supervision.

大型多轮对话池包含逐轮打分时看不见的失败模式：后续请求会偏离原始意图，助手消息会变得重复，回答也可能忽视用户要求的形式。因此，即使选择一批单独很强的轮次，仍可能为多轮指令微调得到不连贯的轨迹。

MDS 追问在固定的对话级监督微调预算中应准入哪些完整对话。它把训练记录从未经筛选的对话池变为同时为用户意图轨迹覆盖和轨迹内部可靠性所选择的集合。干预不是对话模型结构或推理时裁判；它决定哪些完整对话历史成为监督。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The global stage represents a dialogue with the aggregate of its user-query embeddings, rather than assistant responses that may carry stylistic noise. It clusters these trajectories into semantic bins, then greedily selects representative conversations while penalizing near-duplicates inside every bin. This prevents frequent templates from consuming the whole budget and preserves long-tail user intents.

The local stage asks whether a retained dialogue has usable structure. It scores each assistant turn for anchoring to entities introduced by the user and for informative novelty relative to earlier assistant turns, then separately checks whether the answer form matches the query form. A dialogue must pass form consistency and is ranked by its entity coherence–novelty score within its bin. Thus final SFT data couples global coverage with local multi-turn reliability.

全局阶段用用户查询嵌入的聚合表示对话，而不使用可能携带文体噪声的助手回答。它把这些轨迹聚成语义分桶，再在每个桶内贪心选择代表性对话并惩罚近重复。这防止高频模板消耗全部预算，并保留长尾用户意图。

局部阶段询问保留下来的对话是否具有可用结构。它对每个助手轮次评分，看其是否锚定用户引入的实体、是否相对更早助手轮次提供有信息量的新内容，再单独检查回答形式是否符合查询形式。对话必须通过形式一致性，并按桶内实体连贯性—新颖性得分排序。因此最终监督微调数据把全局覆盖与局部多轮可靠性结合。

title: Method
方法
html:
MDS encodes every user query using all-MiniLM-L6-v2, averages query embeddings across turns, runs k-means with 1,000 bins, and retains the top 50% in each bin using a greedy representativeness-minus-redundancy objective. This forms a reduced candidate pool. In the local stage, Qwen3-8B-Instruct extracts answer entities, entities in preceding queries, and entities in preceding answers; the score rewards user grounding and new informative entities. It also rates query-answer form consistency on a 0–2 scale.

The experiment uses Baize for general multi-turn training and a Banking customer-service corpus for domain training. From each corpus, MDS and all baselines select 10K dialogues, expand them into turn-level supervision, and LoRA fine-tune LLaMA3-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B-Instruct for three epochs. The form threshold is 1.0, per-bin quotas follow original bin size, and comparisons cover single-turn selectors, dialogue-level LLM scorers, heuristics, random, full data, and the base model. The official project releases code and resources.

MDS 用 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 编码每个用户查询，跨轮平均查询嵌入，用 1,000 个桶运行 k 均值，并通过代表性减冗余的贪心目标保留每桶前 50%。这形成缩减候选池。在局部阶段，Qwen3-8B-Instruct 提取回答实体、此前查询中的实体和此前回答中的实体；该分数奖励用户锚定和新的有信息量实体。它还以 0–2 的尺度评分查询—回答形式一致性。

实验把 Baize 用于通用多轮训练，把 Banking 客服语料用于领域训练。从每个语料中，MDS 和所有基线选择 10K 段对话，将其展开为逐轮监督，并对 LLaMA3-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B-Instruct 进行三周期 LoRA 微调。形式阈值为 1.0，逐桶配额按原始桶大小分配，比较对象包括单轮选择器、对话级 LLM 评分器、启发式、随机、全数据和基础模型。官方项目发布代码和资源。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Baize with LLaMA3-8B, MDS has the best average rank, 1.25, across twelve MT-Eval, ConsistentChat, and TopDial measures; the next strongest listed average rank is 4.58 for CC-Score. With Qwen3-8B it again obtains 1.25, ahead of 4.67 for DialScore. MDS also avoids the TopDial decline from all-data training: for LLaMA3-8B, all data lowers the LLM-EVAL score from 7.12 to 6.61, while MDS retains 7.12 and reports the highest entity F1 of 0.173.

On the Banking corpus, MDS reaches 6.72 G-EVAL on the in-domain test and 7.30 on out-of-domain ConsistentChat, the highest reported values, with entity F1 close to or above competing selections. Removing either global coverage or local structure lowers MT-Eval and TopDial performance; turning off semantic bins or the form filter particularly lowers TopDial entity F1. The paper further reports that long-turn entity F1 is 0.554 for MDS versus 0.538 for ZIP, and that MDS-only subsets contain fewer topic-drift and unsupported dialogues. These are evidence under LLM-judge and entity-based metrics, not human clinical or safety evaluation.

在使用 LLaMA3-8B 的 Baize 上，MDS 在十二项 MT-Eval、ConsistentChat 和 TopDial 指标上获得最佳平均排名 1.25；所列次强平均排名是 CC-Score 的 4.58。使用 Qwen3-8B 时，它再次得到 1.25，领先 DialScore 的 4.67。MDS 还避免了全数据训练导致的 TopDial 下降：对 LLaMA3-8B，全数据将 LLM-EVAL 从 7.12 降至 6.61，而 MDS 保持 7.12 并报告最高实体 F1 0.173。

在 Banking 语料上，MDS 在领域内测试达到 6.72 的 G-EVAL，在域外 ConsistentChat 达到 7.30，均为报告最高值，实体 F1 接近或高于竞争选择。去掉全局覆盖或局部结构都会降低 MT-Eval 和 TopDial 表现；关闭语义分桶或形式过滤尤其降低 TopDial 实体 F1。论文还报告长轮次实体 F1 中 MDS 为 0.554、ZIP 为 0.538，且仅 MDS 子集含有更少主题漂移和无支持对话。这些是在 LLM 裁判和实体指标下的证据，而非人工临床或安全评估。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Single-turn selection treats every query-answer pair as an independent record, which loses the dependencies that make a later answer useful or harmful in a conversation. MDS makes the complete dialogue the selectable record. Its global component decides whether the set covers varied user intents, while its local component decides whether the turns within a selected record provide grounded and functionally aligned supervision.

The method is not merely a generic LLM quality score applied to dialogue text. It separates user-side semantic trajectories from assistant-side structural signals, uses a hard form-consistency admission condition, and maintains bin-level quotas. This makes its contribution a concrete policy for assembling a multi-turn training consumer: conversation diversity is protected before structural reliability is used to decide which examples fill each semantic budget.

单轮选择把每个查询—回答对当作独立记录，这会丢失让后续回答在对话中有用或有害的依赖。MDS 把完整对话作为可选择记录。其全局部分决定集合是否覆盖多样用户意图，其局部部分决定被选记录内部的轮次是否提供扎实且功能对齐的监督。

该方法不只是对对话文本施加通用 LLM 质量评分。它把用户侧语义轨迹与助手侧结构信号分开，使用硬形式一致性准入条件，并维持分桶配额。这使其贡献成为组装多轮训练消费者的具体策略：在结构可靠性决定哪些例子填满每个语义预算之前，先保护对话多样性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors report that MDS does not substantially reduce contradiction errors, likely because the method deliberately retains longer, structurally richer conversations whose cross-turn dependencies make implicit conflicts difficult to detect. Entity extraction and form scoring rely on an instruction-tuned scorer and prompts, so errors or domain shifts in that scorer can change selection. The primary experiments cover Baize and a Banking corpus, two 8B backbones, and automated LLM-judge or entity metrics; results do not establish behavior for safety-critical conversations, other languages, or very different dialogue sources. Offline scoring also introduces a preprocessing cost that must be weighed against the benefit of a 10K-dialogue subset.

作者报告 MDS 并未显著降低矛盾错误，可能因为该方法有意保留更长、结构更丰富的对话，而其跨轮依赖使隐含冲突更难检测。实体提取和形式评分依赖指令微调评分器及提示，因此该评分器中的错误或领域转移会改变选择。主要实验覆盖 Baize 和 Banking 语料、两个 8B 骨干以及自动 LLM 裁判或实体指标；结果不能确立其在安全关键对话、其他语言或差异很大的对话来源上的行为。离线评分也引入预处理成本，需与 10K 对话子集的收益权衡。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use MDS when the unit of training is a conversation and preserving context across turns matters more than optimizing isolated reply quality. Preserve the dialogue pool revision, query encoder, number of semantic bins, coverage and redundancy weight, global retention fraction, entity-extraction and form-scoring prompts/models, threshold, bin quotas, selected dialogue IDs, turn expansion format, and LoRA training recipe. Compare against whole-dialogue random sampling and turn-level selectors under the same dialogue budget. The official repository and project page provide the release, but source-dialogue privacy, consent, licenses, and domain-specific safety need independent review before deployment.
当训练单位是完整对话，且保留跨轮上下文比优化孤立回答质量更重要时，可使用 MDS。应保留对话池版本、查询编码器、语义桶数量、覆盖与冗余权重、全局保留比例、实体提取与形式评分提示和模型、阈值、分桶配额、所选对话标识、逐轮展开格式和 LoRA 训练配方。应在相同对话预算下与完整对话随机抽样和逐轮选择器比较。官方仓库和项目页提供发布内容，但部署前仍需独立审查来源对话隐私、同意、许可证及领域安全。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The main distinction is that MDS has two different protections against bad data. The global stage protects dataset-level coverage of what users ask; the local stage protects whether a chosen conversation remains on topic, progresses, and answers in the requested form. Its strongest result is the consistent aggregate rank across diverse dialogue measures, not one isolated score. When reproducing, inspect the error-type and order-perturbation analyses as well as benchmarks, because the claim is about preserving cross-turn structure rather than simply selecting more fluent answers.
核心区别是 MDS 对坏数据有两种不同保护。全局阶段保护数据集层面对用户提问的覆盖；局部阶段保护被选择对话是否保持主题、产生进展并以所要求形式回答。其最强结果是跨多种对话指标的一致聚合排名，而非某个孤立分数。复现时应同时检查错误类型和顺序扰动分析以及基准，因为该主张是保存跨轮结构，而不只是选择更流畅的回答。
